ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High bimodal macro-level ratio; large high-intensity (white) patches centrally located on both lobes contrasted against a wide low-intensity (black) perimeter and central connector.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy approximately 40% of the visible surface; left lobe contains two distinct low-intensity circular spots in the upper quadrant; right lobe features a prominent horizontal low-intensity linear streak; high-frequency dark mottling localized along the borders of the white patches.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 35 degrees; depth is significant relative to total lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire boundary; high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (approx. 2-5 pixels) consistent from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex trailing edges transitioning to sharp, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels (barnacles) localized at both distal tips; sparse, smaller white pixel clusters distributed across the lower-central black fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear disruptions (rake marks) visible across white regions; two parallel vertical-diagonal lines on the left lobe and one long horizontal-diagonal streak on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (linear pigment disruptions) across both lobes; dense barnacle colonization and associated tissue scarring at distal fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pair of isolated dark circular spots in the upper-central region of the left lobe's white patch.
